title: A Cheeky Pint with OpenAI cofounder Greg Brockman
description:
🍻 Don't miss the next round of Cheeky Pint! Subscribe to our new channel for all future episodes and clips: https://www.youtube.com/@CheekyPint 

Greg Brockman—OpenAI cofounder and Stripe's first engineer—joins John Collison to talk about research-driven product development, an early moment he thought OpenAI was doomed, S curves in AI advancement, and energy bottlenecks.

Full transcript on Substack: https://substack.com/@cheekypint/note/p-168995216
